They are the greatest heroes the world has ever known: Captain America, Iron Man, Thor, Hulk, Wasp, Giant Man, Hawkeye, Black Widow, Quicksilver and Scarlet Witch. On the eve of Tony and Natasha’s wedding, Nick Fury makes his move against the mysterious traitor who’s been plaguing the team — and the Ultimates will never be the same!
